sql: SELECT T1.nome, T1.uf, AVG(T2.valor_venda) AS preco_medio FROM municipios AS T1 INNER JOIN coletas AS T2 ON T1.municipio_id = T2.municipio_id WHERE T1.uf = 'SP' AND T2.produto = 'GASOLINA' AND T2.data_coleta >= date_trunc('month', '2026-09-01') GROUP BY T1.nome, T1.uf ORDER BY preco_medio DESC LIMIT 1
raw_output: SELECT T1.nome, T1.uf, AVG(T2.valor_venda) AS preco_medio FROM municipios AS T1 INNER JOIN coletas AS T2 ON T1.municipio_id = T2.municipio_id WHERE T1.uf = 'SP' AND T2.produto = 'GASOLINA' AND T2.data_coleta >= date_trunc('month', '2026-09-01') GROUP BY T1.nome, T1.uf ORDER BY preco_medio DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', data_coleta) AS mes, SUM(valor_venda) AS acumulado FROM coletas WHERE produto = 'GNV' AND data_coleta >= '2025-01-01' AND data_coleta <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', data_coleta)
